segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְקַדֵּשׁ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים בְּשָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה, אוֹ אִשָּׁה אַחַת בְּפָחוֹת מִשָּׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁשָּׁלַח סִבְלוֹנוֹת לְאַחַר מִכָּאן
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who betroths two women» together «with» an item «worth one peruta,» so that the value of each woman’s share was not worth one peruta, «or» who betroths «one woman with» an item «worth less than one peruta, despite» the fact «that he later sent» the traditional «gifts [sivlonot]» of a groom to the bride,

segments.he: אֵינָהּ מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת, שֶׁמֵּחֲמַת קִידּוּשִׁין הָרִאשׁוֹנִים שָׁלַח. וְכֵן קָטָן שֶׁקִּידֵּשׁ.
segments.en: «she is not betrothed, because he sent» the gifts «on account of the first betrothal,» i.e., the item whose value to the woman was less than one peruta, and not to effect betrothal. «And similarly,» if there was «a minor who betrothed» a woman, and he sent her gifts after he became an adult, the assumption is that he sent them on account of his betrothal when he was still a minor, and since betrothal performed by a minor is of no account, she is not betrothed.

moves.summary: rules later gifts do not betroth

positions.claim: later sivlonot were sent on account of the first betrothal, so she is not betrothed
